senses.gloss:
Dṛśyatvavicāra
viś. adv. refutations of the Advaitin's view of the illusory nature of the world. MT. 5963.

Dṛśyatvahetubhaṅga
from Nyāyāmṛta (Pariccheda I). MD. 14311.

Dṛśyatvādiniruktikhaṇḍana
criticism of the view of Brahmānanda Sarasvatī an. Madhusūdana Sarasvatī on unreality of the world. MT. 7420.

Dṛśyatvānumānanirāsa
or Prapañcamithyātvānumānakhaṇḍana. viś. adv. by Anantācārya of the Śeṣārya family (See NCC. I. p. 186b). Adyar D. X. 355. Extr. p. 329.
Pt.. Śāstramuktāvalī Ser. 32. 1909.

Dṛśyatvānumānavicāra
dvai. Mysore III. p. 16 (inc.).

Dṛśyaviṣayatākhaṇḍana
adv. an. C. by Acyutarāya Moḍaka. Baroda 12378.

Dṛśyonmārjanikāprakaraṇa
adv. by Śaṅkuśāstrin. Baroda 6820 (a..

Dṛṣṭakūṭaṭīkā
a.. contains riddles along with their explanations. RASB. VII. 5540.

Dṛṣṭakūṭārṇava
a collection of riddles by Kāśīnātha, son of Pāṇḍuraṅga Parava. RASB. VII. 5532.

Dṛṣṭakūta
Mithilā.

Dṛṣṭavidhi
Jain. jy. Jainagranthāvalī p. 153.

Dṛṣṭāntakathā
Jain. BORI. 1307 of 1887-91.

Dṛṣṭāntakalikā
or ºzataka by Kusumadeva. IO. 7227. 7228. K. 60.

Dṛṣṭāntagarbhastutidvātriṃśikā
Jain. (Beg. dRSTAntabhUmiH kimivAsti vastuto) by Rāmacandrasūri.
Pt.. Jainastotrasandoha: Pt. I. p.. 144-47.

Dṛṣṭāntatraya
BORI. 742 of 1899-1915.

Dṛṣṭāntadūṣaṇa
Jain. BORI. 291D of Ā882-83. [Page098-b] D. p. 327. Jainagranthāvalī p. 84. Peters. I. p. 126 (no. 291 (5)).

Dṛṣṭāntapaṅkti
Bud. by Aśvaghoṣa (?).
Same a. Kalpanāmaṇḍitikā. See NCC. III. p. 235a.

Dṛṣṭāntamālā
or ºratnAvali Jain. by Arimalla. Jainagranthāvalī p. 180.
Pt.. Jamnagar, 1925-26.

Dṛṣṭāntamālya
Bud. Cordier III. p. 432. Tibetan title for Dṛṣṭāntapaṅkti; see Sylvain Levi, J.. 215 (July-Dec. 1929) 271-80.

Dṛṣṭāntara
yoga. metrical in 4 or 5 adhys. Burnell 113a (2 mss.). TD. 6737-42. 8998. Some of these mss. are given in Burnell 96a a. Kapilagītā (NCC. III. p. 153a).

Dṛṣṭāntaratnākara
Jain. BP. p.. 172b. 244b. Jainagranthāvalī p. 267.

Dṛṣṭāntaśataka
Jain. unspecified. BP. p. 250a. Chani 792. 1885. 2476. Jainagranthāvalī p. 208. Malakheda 13. Mysore I. p. 247.
--or Nītisāra. by Ghaṭakarpara. RASB. VII. 5493.
Pt.. Kāvyasaṅgraha I. p.. 374-80. Calcutta, 1888.
--or ºkalikā. subhāṣita. by Kusumadeva. Assam Kāvyas 20. Ben. 36. IIO. Stein 71. IM. 8927B (inc.). IO. 7227. 7228. K. 60. Pannalal Bombay IV. p. 27. Radh. 21. RASB. VII. 5485. SB. 323. Trav. Uni. 9831.
Pt.. (1) Haeberlin, p.. 217-26, Calcutta, 1847. (2) with Bengali transl. Calcutta, 1917. (3) Kāvyasaṅgraha, Vol. II. 3rd edn. (1888) p.. 98-125. (4) K. M. Gucch. XIV (1906) p.. 69-77. See also NCC. IV. p. 258b.
--by Tejassim3ha, pupil of Keśava. BORI. 291 of 1871-72. 1141 of 1884-87. [Page099-a. 450 of 1899-1915. D. p. 34. Gu. 9. Jainagranthāvalī p. 208. JBhP. I. 1257. 1258 (inc.). 1259.
--by Narendrasūri. BORI. 1373 of 1887-91 (with Avacūri). Jainagranthāvalī p. 209.
--C. Avacūri. ibid.

Dṛṣṭāntasiddhāñjana
name of C. by Kallolabhaṭṭācārya on Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā of his grandfather, Sujana.
See NCC. III. p. 263.

Dṛṣṭāṣṭaka(stotra)
Jain. on the feelings of joy of a Jaina devotee a. the sight of a Jaina temple. Adyar II. p. 241a. Adyar D. IV. 3191. Arrah I. p. 14 (4 mss.). Jhalrapatan p.. 77. 83. 124 (a..) (4 mss.). MD. 9469-71. 11372. 16378. 18401. Moodbidri I. 201 (d). II. 400 (28). 519 (b). Pannalal Bombay I. p. 74 (Pt..). Strassburg Dig. p. 7.

Dṛṣṭijñāna
Bud.
--(Vajra) Gītikā. Cordier II. p.. 232. 233.

Dṛṣṭijñānamahākośadharmadhātu
Bud. by Śrīsim3ha. Cordier III. p. 235.

Dṛṣṭidoṣaśānti
śaivāgama. Mysore I. p. 112.
C.. Dṛgdoṣaśānti above.

Dṛṣṭidvāra
Jain. Chani 1951.

Dṛṣṭiphala(bhāvādhyāya)
jy. B. IV. 148 (2 mss.).

Dṛṣṭibhedaśāstra
TA. 94.

Dṛṣṭivāda
or diThThipavAya Jain. Pkt. BORI. 610 of 1875-76. D. p. 109. Jainagranthāvalī p. 90. Weber 1822. 1823 (extr.).
See Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas p.. 54. 75-77. 82.

Dṛṣṭisādhana
jy. Bikaner 4766. [Page099-b]

Dṛṣṭisāraṇīya
or Dṛṣṭisādhana. Allahabad 172.

Dṛṣṭyānayanādi
Trav. Uni. L. 144N (inc.).
